source_caption:
To authentically capture the deeply relatable, messy emotional core of a teenager caught in a massive coming-of-age love triangle, creator Jenny Han took an incredible casting risk on a complete unknown. When the exhaustive search for Belly Conklin began, Lola Tung had absolutely no professional on-screen experience and was just a college freshman taking remote classes at Carnegie Mellon. Auditioning entirely over Zoom during the pandemic, Tung managed to project such a raw, unpolished vulnerability that Han instantly knew she had found her lead. By stepping onto a massive television production for the very first time and effortlessly carrying the emotional weight of the entire series, Tung brilliantly proves that the most captivating performances often don’t come from years of polished Hollywood training, but from the genuine, unvarnished innocence of a young actor discovering their own power in real time.
⠀
The Summer I Turned Pretty (2022-2025), created by Jenny Han, starring Lola Tung, Christopher Briney, Gavin Casalegno. A teenage girl experiences a deeply transformative, unpredictable summer at a picturesque beach house when she suddenly finds herself caught in a heartbreaking, complicated love triangle between two brothers she has known her entire life.

source_details.synopsis: The Summer I Turned Pretty is an American coming-of-age romantic drama television series created by author Jenny Han for Amazon Prime Video. It is based on her novel trilogy: The Summer I Turned Pretty, It's Not Summer Without You, and We'll Always Have Summer. Lola Tung stars as Isabel "Belly" Conklin, a teenager involved in a love triangle with brothers Conrad and Jeremiah, played by Christopher Briney and Gavin Casalegno, respectively. Production on the TV series began in 2021. It premiered on June 17, 2022, with the first season consisting of seven episodes.
